steps.title: Amplify Target Amplicon Sequence
steps.instruction: Amplify the target amplicon sequence using the appropriate primer pairs following the specified protocol section 'For 1' PCR head-primers' (dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kxygx3k6wg8j/v1).

steps.title: Clean-up PCR Product
steps.instruction: Verify the success of the first PCR reaction via gel electrophoresis, then perform a clean-up to remove proteins, salts, dNTPs, and primers following the specified protocol (dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bp2l695eklqe/v1).

steps.title: Perform Barcoding
steps.instruction: Perform the barcoding step following the section 'For 2' PCR barcoded-head primers' (dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kxygx3k6wg8j/v1).

steps.title: Verify Barcoding
steps.instruction: Check the success of the barcoding step for the amplicon by running gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: Calculate Pooling Ratio
steps.instruction: Determine the pooling ratio to avoid losing amplicons of different lengths using the formula: Amount of long amplicon = Length ratio × 1.5, where length ratio = length of the long amplicon / length of the short amplicon.

steps.title: Initial Thermocycler Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample in a thermocycler at 20 °C for 30 minutes and 65 °C for 30 minutes, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Overnight Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample overnight at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Buffers and Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers and beads for purification.

substeps.instruction: Thaw either Long Fragment Buffer (LFB) for amplicons >3K or Short Fragment Buffer (SFB) for amplicons <3K at room temperature on a cooling block; mix by vortexing, spin down, and place on ice.
Resuspend AMPure XP beads by vortexing.

steps.title: Bead-Based DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Perform bead-based purification of the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.55X AMPure XP Beads (AXP) to the tube (calculate amount based on input DNA length determined by agarose gel) and mix by flicking.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Spin down the sample and pellet on a magnet; keep the tube on the magnet and pipette off the supernatant.
Wash beads by adding 125 µL LFB or SFB; flick to resuspend, spin down, and pellet on the magnetic rack.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Spin down, place back on the magnet, and pipette off any residual supernatant.
Allow to dry for 5–30 seconds (do not dry until the pellet cracks).
Remove tube from magnet and resuspend pellet in 15 µL Elution Buffer (EB).
Spin down and incubate for 10 minutes at 37 °C on an incubator.
Pellet beads on a magnet for at least 1 minute until the eluate is clear and colorless.
Transfer the elute into a new clean tube.

steps.title: Quantify and Store Library
steps.instruction: Quantify the DNA concentration using Qubit (target: 50 ng/ul for a good library) and store the library on ice until loading.

steps.title: Prepare Flow Cell Priming Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the flow cell and priming reagents.

substeps.instruction: Thaw the Flow cell, Sequencing Buffer (SB), and Library Bead (LIB) at room temperature, then mix by vortexing.
Combine 1,170 µl Flow Cell Flush (FCF) and 30 µl Flow Cell Tether (FCT); mix by pipetting at room temperature.

steps.title: Prime the Flow Cell
steps.instruction: Prime the flow cell while ensuring no air bubbles are present in the flow path.

substeps.instruction: Slide the priming port cover clockwise to open. Check for air bubbles under the cover.
Remove bubbles: Set a P1000 pipette to 800 μl, insert into the priming port, and turn the wheel until the dial shows 820–830 µl or buffer enters the tip.
Load 800 μl of priming mix into the flow cell via the priming port by turning the pipet wheel. Wait 10 minutes.
Load an additional 200 μl of priming mix into the flow cell via the priming port to ensure all pores are open.

steps.title: Prepare Library for Loading
steps.instruction: Prepare the final library mix in a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube during the priming wait time.

substeps.instruction: Combine 37.5 µl Sequencing Buffer (SB), 25.5 µl Library Beads (LIB) (mix LIB immediately before use as they settle quickly), and 12 µl DNA library.

steps.title: Load Library onto Flow Cell
steps.instruction: Load the prepared library into the flow cell.

substeps.instruction: Gently flip the prepared library just prior to loading.
Lift the SpotON sample port cover.
Using a 200 µl tip, add the library to the SpotON sample port in a dropwise fashion, ensuring each drop flows in before adding the next, while keeping the priming port cover open.

steps.title: Start Sequencing
steps.instruction: Seal the device and initiate the run.

substeps.instruction: Gently close the SpotON sample port cover (ensure bung enters the port), close the priming port, cover the sensor array with the sensory cover, and close the MinION lid.
Start the sequencing process using MinKNOW software.

steps.title: Flow Cell Wash Procedure
steps.instruction: Wash the flow cell after sequencing or when pausing.

substeps.instruction: Stop or pause the experiment in MinKNOW; keep the flow cell at 4 °C if not washing immediately.

Prepare Flow Cell Wash Mix: Combine 1 µl Wash Mix (WMX) (keep on ice, do not vortex) and 199 µl Wash Diluent (DIL) (thaw at RT, vortex, spin down, place on ice) in a 1.5 mL microtube. Mix by pipetting; do not vortex.
Lift the sensory cover; ensure priming and SpotON port covers are in position.
Rotate the priming port cover clockwise to open.
Remove air bubbles: Set P1000 to 800 μl, insert into port, and turn wheel to 820–830 µl until liquid enters the tip. Verify continuous buffer across the sensor array.
Load 200 μl of prepared Flow Cell Wash Mix into the priming port.
Close the priming port and store at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Flow Cell Storage and Recovery
steps.instruction: Prepare the flow cell for storage or subsequent use.

substeps.instruction: Remove MinION device from 4 °C fridge.
Thaw Storage Buffer (S) at room temperature on a cooling block; mix by pipetting and spin down.
Open the device lid and rotate the priming port cover clockwise to open.
Remove air bubbles: Set P1000 to 800 μl, insert into port, and turn wheel to 820–830 µl until liquid enters the tip. Verify continuous buffer across the sensor array.
Add 500 μl of Storage Buffer (S) through the priming port by turning the pipet wheel.
Close the priming port.
Using a P1000, remove all fluids from Waste port 2. Ensure priming and SpotON ports are closed to prevent air from entering the sensor array.
Perform a Flow Cell Check and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Configure MinKNOW Software
steps.instruction: Set up the sequencing run in the software.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the start page and click 'Start sequencing'.
Enter experiment details (name, flow cell position, sample ID).
Select Ligation sequencing Kit (SQK-LSK114) without choosing sub-options and continue.
